speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether HDB can include the construction of portable/fixed ramps at main entrances of HDB flats that have more than a single step as part of the Enhancement for Active Seniors funding package/scheme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: And for those who need help with financial assistance, they can also seek assistance from ComCare, SG Enable, as well as various VWOs.
